market_scope: HOY Mar Menor · Family direct-resolution audit
decision: Desk research cannot safely close any of the six remaining cases. Preserve the 2.42 states until direct operator or official-host evidence resolves each material conflict.
rules: Operator or official-host evidence outranks directories and aggregators.
Do not resolve material conflicts by majority vote.
Do not publish precise hours while credible current sources disagree.
Do not infer Family geometry such as sightline, access, fence, shade or walking separation from maps, addresses or reviews alone.
Do not copy or hotlink third-party media without a separate rights decision.
This audit is read-only research and performs no Supabase, migration or seed writes.
